thread.title: Report: Apple acquired AI startup Silk Labs - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Report: Apple acquired AI startup Silk Labs - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) quietly acquired AI startup Silk Labs, according to The Information sources.
Silk Labs makes AI software light enough to fit into small devices like cameras and smart home devices.
The acquisition happened earlier this year, but this is the first time it was reported.
Silk Labs had about a dozen employees and had only raised $4M in private funding, so it was likely a smaller purchase.
